description: combine cross (formerly SPECCROS) makes a weighted substitution of the spectral amplitudes of the first PVOC file with those of the second — a timbral crossover, not a full morph. Single-degree control via interp.
musical_use: Impose the spectral-amplitude character of one sound onto another by a controllable amount. Lighter than a morph (weighted, not full substitution); good as a standalone timbral blend or as preparation that moves one sound toward another's timbral field before morphing. With a time-varying interp envelope, the crossover can sweep from none to full across the file. On inputs of differing length, CDP produces output the duration of the shorter input (order-independent).

interp.description: Degree of replacement of input1's channel amplitudes by input2's. 0 = input1 unchanged; 1 = full amplitude replacement. Weighted crossover. May vary over time (breakpoint envelope scales to input1's duration).

examples.description: Halfway timbral crossover: impose input2's spectral amplitudes onto input1 by 50%.
examples.expected_use: Standalone timbral blend, or to move one sound toward another's timbral field before a morph.
